issues.description: The problem statement and template refer to an interface named 'Milkable', but the solution repository uses an interface named 'Dairy' (and the solution's Milkable.java is an empty file). Goat and Seal in the solution implement 'Dairy' instead of 'Milkable', which is a type/name mismatch that will confuse students about which interface to implement and prevents direct mapping between the specification and the provided solution files.
issues.suggestedFix: Make interface naming consistent across artifacts. Either (a) rename the solution's 'Dairy' interface to 'Milkable' and update Goat and Seal to implement Milkable (and remove or populate the empty Milkable.java), or (b) update the problem statement and template to refer to 'Dairy' instead of 'Milkable'. Ensure only one interface file exists with the expected method signature (messageOnMilk()).
